changes: New: DRUMMAP, Mutable Instruments Grids' drum map as a track machine for Flex and Static samples (SRC SETUP, like VECTOR).
PART picks BD, SD or HH; X and Y move through Grids' 25 patterns; FILL sets the density, CHAO varies every 32-step pass; YES draws a new variation.
Accents keep the Part's VOL, plain hits sit AVEL below; the trigs and VOL locks are ordinary sequencer data.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Card firmware cannot include it.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
